title: The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, August 8, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, August 8, 8th, Apple (AAPL), Disney (DIS), Merck (MRK) and Pfizer (PFE). down -11 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +126.73 (+0.50%) at 25,628.91.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.68%.
There were 22 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) +2.08% and Exxon Mobil (XOM) +1.36%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Apple (APPL) -0.94% and Walgreens (WBA) -0.55%.
Disney (DIS +0.53%) slipped 3% in after-hours trading after it reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $1.87, below estimates of $2.005.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
